      "resolution": "Strip inspector env when spawning windowd. Prefer a normal terminal for pnpm dev.",
      "category": "tooling"
    },

      "timestamp": "2026-08-20T15:00:00",

      "resolution": "Clear NODE_OPTIONS entirely for the windowd child. Disable HMR in the generated vite.config.js. Retry once if windowd exits within 5s with code 0.",
      "category": "tooling"
    }
